description: Every complete example from Snowflake's Scripting LOOPS documentation page, with the answer each one gives on a REAL ACCOUNT. Doc examples are the cheapest fidelity check there is - self-contained, and their answers can be MEASURED rather than reasoned about. These fourteen cover all six loop constructs (the counter, cursor and RESULTSET FOR loops; WHILE; REPEAT; LOOP; BREAK; CONTINUE) and found two grammar gaps the unit tests had not: LIMIT :bind, and a loop LABEL spelled INNER. The expected values were recorded from the account BEFORE the engine was changed, which is the point - a doc page states what an example DOES, and the account states what it ANSWERS. Converted from scripting/ScriptingLoopsDocExamplesTest (now retired), which ran all fourteen inside ONE @Test over a String[][] table; each example is its own test here, so a failure names the example rather than the loop.
